name: Giving What We Can
summary: Promotes effective giving through the 10% Pledge, research on where to give and a donation platform; its members give to global health, animal welfare and catastrophic-risk charities. Run by Effective Ventures until August 2024, now independent (Giving What We Can UK and Giving What We Can USA).

spending.source: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/11WqiYhOUnfms7MWfF1cbornr8kcfsazdLgMZGdDxIUk/edit (Giving What We Can's 2023–2024 impact evaluation working sheet, 'Financial costs': annual expenses $1,869,506 in 2024, $1,991,339 in 2023, its internal figures across the entities that ran it: Effective Ventures Foundation UK and USA until 25 August 2024, Giving What We Can UK and USA after. No one entity's audited accounts cover the year: Giving What We Can UK's (charity 1207964, period to 31 December 2024) show £239,842 of its own spending and £404,443 of grants to recipients, which are donors' money passed on, not its spending.)
